We are looking for a Field Area Manager Denmark who will be placed within the Nordic HQ in Copenhagen. The successful candidate will manage client relationships, monitor sales performance, and ensure consistent growth in wholesale distribution in the assigned area. Key responsibilities include executing sales strategies and maintaining strong partnerships with vendors and clients. The position will report to the Head of Wholesale Nordic within and work closely also with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and alignment with company objectives.

**Main activities and responsibilities:

**

• Define and develop wholesale channel distribution across multibrand stores in Denmark, Iceland, Greenland and Faroe Islands, ensuring the achievement of assigned targets, like-for-like (L4L) growth, and business development across all product categories.

• Regularly visit existing and potential clients to strengthen relationships and expand business opportunities.

• Negotiate Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgets with clients, ensuring the application of company commercial terms and standard policies.

**

• Proven experience in Denmark market with strong, stable relationships established with key accounts in the region.

• Goal-oriented, with the ability to assign specific targets for each client, whether active or potential, within their area of responsibility.

• Skilled in ensuring the correct execution of planned commercial strategies, as well as overseeing administrative and logistical processes.

• Fluent in written and spoken in Danish and English.

• Excellent interpersonal and commercial skills, with strong communication, organizational, and negotiation abilities.

• Proficient in using the Office suite and key software tools, capable of updating, monitoring, and periodically sharing reports and sales results, and implementing corrective actions when needed.

• Willingness to travel frequently within the region, for at least 50% of the working time.

• Experience in organizing marketing activities aimed at developing the brand in both commercial terms and market positioning.

• Excellent knowledge of products, brand positioning, and competitor analysis, with strong abilities in identifying market trends and monitoring volumes and price trends

As a Specialist, Digital Engagement, you will play a key role in bringing Pandora’s global campaigns to life across digital touchpoints. You will plan, develop, and execute content across web and email, ensuring engaging and high-performing consumer journeys that align with both brand storytelling and commercial priorities.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will support campaigns end-to-end - from briefing through to execution - ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous optimisation across channels and markets. You will also contribute to refining customer journeys by leveraging insights, performance data, and user behaviour.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute digital campaigns across web and email in line with global brand and commercial strategies

• Translate campaign concepts into engaging, high-performing digital experiences

• Coordinate content across channels and ensure consistency across markets

• Support end-to-end campaign delivery, from briefing to implementation

• Analyse performance data and apply insights to optimise campaigns and customer journeys

• Contribute to continuous improvement of content, placements, and user experience

• Provide guidance and support on local campaign execution

**Your impact

**You will directly influence the quality and effectiveness of Pandora’s digital campaigns and customer journeys across owned channels. Through strong execution and continuous optimisation, you will drive improved engagement, conversion, and brand consistency, while strengthening e-commerce and email performance and enhancing the overall digital customer experience.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you bring a solid foundation of experience, strong practical skills, and a proactive, hands-on mindset:

**Experience

**

• Approx. 3+ years of experience in digital campaigns, e-commerce, email, or content management

• Experience working within digital marketing, ideally across web and email environments

• Track record of executing digital campaigns and projects

**Skills

**

• Hands-on experience delivering digital-first campaigns in an e-commerce and email

• setup

• Strong understanding of customer journeys and cross-channel execution

• Experience creating engaging digital shopping experiences

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into optimisation actions

• Ability to analyse performance data and improve marketing and business KPIs

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience from a global organisation is a plus

**Tools

**

• Proficiency in tools such as Excel, Jira, Figma, and PowerPoint

**Key stakeholders

**You will collaborate closely with a broad range of teams across the business to bring campaigns to life end-to-end. This includes colleagues working with brand and creative development, media and marketing activation, retail, and customer engagement (including email and loyalty).

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**We are looking for a Production Test Development Engineer

****The role

**We are looking for a curious engineer to join the Production Test Development team.

We work in an industry on the path to industrialization. We have a high mix and low volume, deep tech portfolio therefore we are innovative in our approach to implement testing schemes meeting both product requirements and available hardware – but always aiming to create robust test schemes for our on-site production.

You will work on new development projects, ensuring consistency with current test portfolio, and together with the test designer and product technical lead, design and code new test programs.

You will support our production environment by securing minimum downtime and optimizing test routines to ensure products of high quality and reproducibility.

Together with the rest of the team, you will continuously support our test framework and drive continuous improvement across our test programs.

**What do we expect of you?

**You have production test development experience, preferably in an industrial setting.

You have strong competencies in TestStand, LabVIEW, general instrumentation, and signal analysis.

Experience in MS-SQL database integration is considered a plus.

We prefer that you hold a degree in engineering.

Fluency in English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Keep your personal data safe

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**As Genmab continues its transformation into a fully integrated global biotech company, the Head of Total Rewards will architect a future-ready, technology-enabled global rewards strategy that aligns with our purpose, growth ambitions, and values.

This leader will combine expertise in executive compensation, global scalability, and digital enablement to create a next-generation total rewards model—anchored in data, automation, and human experience. The role will also build the structures, systems, and shared-service capabilities needed to scale efficiently while maintaining governance, equity, and agility.

The location is flexible across Genmab’s global hubs (Princeton, Copenhagen, Utrecht). We have a hybrid model that requires being onsite 60% of the time.

**Responsibilities

****Strategic Design & Operating Model

**

• Define and lead the evolution of Genmab’s total rewards philosophy and structure to support a global, end-to-end biotech organization.

• Design a modern total rewards operating model that integrates regional teams, shared services, and centers of excellence for consistent global delivery.

• Drive process standardization and automation to improve quality, transparency, and efficiency.

• Lead a strategic compensation team responsible for developing forward-looking frameworks, tools, and analytics that enable proactive support to HR Business Partners, Talent, and other COE stakeholders.

• Ensure the Total Rewards function continuously evolves its offerings to meet the changing needs of a high-growth, science-driven organization.

**Executive Compensation & Governance

**

• Serve as lead advisor to the Board’s Remuneration Committee on executive and equity compensation.

• Design performance-based and ESG-linked long-term incentive plans aligned with Genmab’s business strategy and culture.

• Ensure strong governance, compliance, and transparency in all executive pay matters.

• Bring external perspective and best-in-class practices to inform committee discussions and program evolution, ensuring Genmab remains competitive within the biotech and broader life sciences markets.

**Global Rewards Strategy & Wellbeing

**

• Oversee global compensation, benefits, recognition, and mobility programs that balance competitiveness, scalability, and inclusivity.

• Integrate skills-based pay, internal mobility, and evolving career architectures into the total rewards framework.

• Evolve wellbeing and flexibility offerings through technology and personalized employee experiences.

• Champion employee understanding and appreciation of Total Rewards by partnering with Communications and HR to create clear, engaging messaging that connects programs to our purpose, values, and “EVP”.

• Regularly assess market trends, benchmark data, and emerging innovations to identify opportunities for differentiation and continuous improvement.

**Technology, Automation & Data

**

• Lead implementation of digital total rewards platforms and process automation across compensation, benefits, and equity administration.

• Establish robust analytics capabilities for pay equity, retention risk, and predictive modeling.

• Drive continuous improvement through data insights, benchmarking, and feedback loops.

• Leverage advanced analytics to generate actionable insights for business leaders, enabling data-driven decisions around talent retention, productivity, and performance outcomes.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement

**

• Strengthen global governance structures and ensure alignment with regulatory, financial, and ethical standards.

• Create transparency and consistency through standardized processes, policies, and data.

• Build and mentor a global total rewards team with strong analytical and design skills.

**Requirements

**

• 15+ years of experience in total rewards, with significant leadership in global, complex organizations.

• Deep expertise in executive compensation design, governance, and disclosure.

• Proven success implementing technology, analytics, and automation within HR or total rewards functions.

• Experience designing shared-service or center of excellence models across geographies.

• Strong understanding of compensation and benefits regulations across multiple markets.

• Exceptional ability to influence and communicate at the executive and Board level.

• Demonstrated success leading and developing global teams, fostering capability growth and functional excellence.

• Proven ability to translate external best practices and market intelligence into actionable strategies tailored to the biotech industry.

**Attributes

**

• Visionary leader who designs systems for long-term scalability.

• Digital innovator who applies automation and analytics to improve the employee experience.

• Trusted advisor who balances strategic foresight with operational excellence.

• Inclusive, globally minded leader who champions fairness and sustainability in rewards.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

**About the Team

**At the Enterprise Process Management (EPM) unit, our north star is “Partnering towards process excellence.” As Danske Bank’s internal consultancy, the Process Intelligence team collaborates across the organization to drive impactful process improvements and embed operational excellence, deliivering real value. We work side-by-side with business units and agile tribes, supporting strategic growth initiatives and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Our Process Partners play a key role in driving transformations for efficiency and building capabilities in process management. By leveraging Lean methodologies and best practices, we help optimize processes, reduce waste, enhance customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance, and strengthen the organization’s ability to deliver sustainable results. We coach leaders to translate operational excellence principles into lasting behavioural change

**What You Will Do

**

• Drive end-to-end process optimization initiatives, applying Lean principles and eliminating waste.

• Lead and participate in projects focused on customer journeys, process transformation, and change management, using methods such as DMAIC.

• Identify and prioritize organizational benefits, aligning process improvements with business goals and customer needs.

• Project/program management experience (e.g., Agile, Prince2, PMP), with process management or operational excellence as a core methodology.

• Strong skills in business process improvement, change management, and stakeholder engagement.

• Ability to influence without formal authority and thrive in a large, complex organization.

• Experience in delivering training or mentoring on Lean/process improvement.

• Systemic thinking, pragmatic problem-solving, and the ability to structure ambiguity.

Senior Outsourcing Manager

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Outsourcing Manager, you will lead the outsourcing projects that keep Novo’s drug development moving. Working with experts across Novo and external CMO partners worldwide, you will drive strong progress and high-quality deliveries from project start to completion. You will also be part of shaping global strategic CMO collaborations, bringing new treatments closer to the people who need them. Your impact begins with every project you lead.

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring solid drug development experience and the confidence to lead across functions and organisations.

• A MSc or PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering or another relevant life science.

• 4–6+ years of experience from the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or another highly regulated industry.

• A strong understanding of the R&D value chain, drug development processes and Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) requirements.

• Experience with outsourcing, CMO/CDMO collaboration and ideally contract negotiations.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, and the ability to navigate a complex, interdisciplinary organisation.

• The ability to create structure, turn information into clear presentations and build trust across functions and with external partners.

• A proactive, positive and independent way of working, and the ability to manage several tasks at once in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

**What You’ll Do

**You will manage outsourcing projects within drug substance and chemical synthesis, and make sure Novo and its CMO partners work as one team.

• Lead outsourcing projects from initiation to completion, keeping progress strong and deliveries high in quality.

• Select and approve CMOs, and build collaborative external partnerships.

• Negotiate and maintain relevant agreements in close collaboration with Contract Managers.

• Protect Novo’s intellectual property rights while delivering high-quality assessments on time.

• Bring colleagues across Novo together, using informal leadership to influence decisions, drive progress and lead complex projects with colleagues and partners.

• You will have significant responsibility and visibility across the business unit, using your informal leadership to influence decisions, drive progress, and lead complex projects with colleagues and partners.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the CMC Outsourcing & Business Development team in CMC Development, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply. CMC Development develops, manufactures and distributes drug candidates for non-clinical and clinical trials. The CMC Outsourcing team supports the Novo development pipeline and has around 30 experienced colleagues responsible for sourcing and outsourcing activities across CMC Development.

Based in Bagsværd, you will work with external CMO partners globally and with colleagues across Global Research, Quality, Regulatory, Chemical Development, Manufacturing Development, Purchasing and Commercial Manufacturing. Close collaboration with Contract Managers will help you move agreements forward. You will have significant responsibility and visibility across the business unit, and the clarity you create around priorities will help teams decide, act and deliver.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to take the lead on complex projects and be visible across the business unit. The role gives you broad organisational exposure across the drug development value chain, and the chance to build new skills while working with experts inside and outside Novo.

We embrace experimentation and strive for excellence without fixating on perfection. You will have a team to contribute to, and the support to perform at your best.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 to 1,091,600 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn strong partnerships into progress for Novo’s drug development pipeline, apply for the Senior Outsourcing Manager role by 8 November 2026.

**Vice President, Head of Thickening

****Job Description

****Location

**Global

**Reports To

**Product Group Head – Separation

**Role Purpose

**The Head of Thickening role is accountable for the global business performance and growth of the Thickener product offerings across the entire product lifecycle, encompassing both Capital equipment and Upgrades & Rebuilds (U&R).

This role owns the global P&L, commercial strategy, market positioning, pricing strategy, and product roadmap. Responsible for driving aggressive volume growth while protecting and growing profitability targets by maximizing customer value and ensuring a seamless customer offering throughout the lifecycle of installed equipment.

Working across a complex matrix organization, the VP leads the commercialization of both new equipment, upgrades and rebuilds, partnering closely with Capital Sales, Regional Sales, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and Services, to accelerate growth and create sustainable competitive advantage.

**Executive Profile

**The successful candidate must combine strong commercial leadership with a recognized understanding of thickening technologies and their application in minerals processing.

While supported by a team of product managers, application engineers, and technical experts, the Head of Thickening must possess sufficient technical depth and industry credibility to engage confidently with customers, challenge assumptions, evaluate product strategies, and make informed business decisions. The role requires an executive capable of driving business growth while serving as a trusted authority on the Thickener portfolio across both Capital equipment and lifecycle solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Business and P&L Leadership

**

• Own the global P&L for the Thickeners portfolio, including Revenue, Operating Income, Contribution Margin, market share, and profitability.

• Develop and execute the long-term business strategy and growth plan for both Capital and Upgrades & Rebuilds businesses.

• Deliver aggressive growth targets through expansion of equipment sales, modernization programs, and installed-base opportunities.

• Manage business performance through rigorous forecasting, pipeline reviews, financial analysis, and strategic planning.

• Lead and develop a global team of Product Managers, Product Engineers, Applications / Proposals, Technical sales, etc.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer value, growth, and execution.

• Identify and develop new revenue streams, market opportunities, and business models that enhance lifecycle value creation.

**Commercial Leadership

**

• Define and implement global commercial strategies for Capital and U&R offerings.

• Lead the global sales growth agenda by partnering with Capital Sales teams, Regional Sales organizations, and key account leaders.

• Drive pipeline generation, conversion improvement, and sales excellence across all regions.

• Establish and govern global pricing strategies that optimize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.

• Support major commercial negotiations and customer engagements for strategic opportunities.

• Monitor market dynamics, customer trends, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities and business risks.

**Upgrades & Rebuilds Growth

**

• Own the global strategy, growth, and profitability of the Upgrades & Rebuilds business within the Thickeners portfolio.

• Develop lifecycle offerings that increase customer productivity, sustainability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with regional commercial teams to identify modernization, expansion, and rebuild opportunities across the installed base.

• Establish standardized upgrade packages, retrofit solutions, and value propositions that are scalable globally.

• Drive alignment between global product strategy and regional commercial execution.

**Product and Portfolio Strategy

**

• Define the global product roadmap and lifecycle strategy for the Thickeners portfolio.

• Collaborate with Engineering to prioritize innovation investments and technology development.

• Lead market assessments to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive opportunities.

• Ensure product offerings remain differentiated, profitable, and aligned with market requirements.

• Drive standardization, product optimization, digital offerings, and sustainable technology initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Leadership

**

• Lead and influence a highly matrixed global organization without relying solely on direct authority.

• Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Services, Finance, and Regional leadership teams to execute business objectives.

• Ensure alignment between commercial commitments, operational capabilities, and customer expectations.

• Support execution excellence throughout the order lifecycle to maximize customer satisfaction and long-term portfolio success.

**Candidate Profile

**The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business leader with deep experience in thickening technology and minerals processing. They have successfully managed a significant product line, business unit, or portfolio with responsibility for growth, profitability, and market strategy. They are equally comfortable discussing thickener performance and applications with customers and engineers as they are leading commercial negotiations, reviewing business performance, and driving strategic growth initiatives.

**Experience

**

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience within mining, minerals processing, capital equipment, or industrial technology businesses.

• Significant experience with thickening technologies, dewatering solutions, or adjacent process equipment used in mineral processing operations.

• Demonstrated understanding of thickener applications, customer processes, operational challenges, product performance drivers, and aftermarket opportunities throughout the equipment lifecycle.

• Proven success leading a global business, product line, service line, or business unit with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.

• Strong commercial leadership experience, including business development, sales strategy, pricing, market expansion, and P&L ownership.

• Track record of driving growth across both capital equipment sales and aftermarket offerings such as upgrades, rebuilds, modernization programs, and lifecycle services.

• Experience working across highly matrixed global organizations and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Established credibility engaging with customers, engineering teams, technical specialists, and regional commercial organizations at a strategic level.

**Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.

**Core Competencies

**

• Commercial Leadership

• P&L Management

• Strategic Thinking

• Stakeholder Management

• People Leadership

• Thickening Technology Expertise

• Sales & Business Development

• Lifecycle Solutions Management

• Results orientation

We are seeking our new Service Technician to join our team in Copenhagen

**Keep the taps flowing and the good times pouring.

**We are looking for a Service & Maintenance Technician to join our crew of five and ensure every pour of beer hits the glass. Based out of Copenhagen, you’ll install, service and clean tap systems across some of the best bars, restaurants, and vibrant festivals throughout Denmark and Skåne. If you love working with your hands, solving technical puzzles on the fly, and making sure our beloved beers and beverages keep the highest level of quality every single time, this job is for you.

**Who is To Øl?

**To Øl is a young Danish craft brewery founded in 2010. We are striving to deliver the highest quality beer and get it into the hands of people in the most sustainable way. In 2019, we acquired the old Beauvais factory in Svinninge, where we established a modern brewery. We brew a wide range of different beers, and our commitment to quality and innovation has enabled us to export our products to more than 31 countries.

Our company consists of over 80 dedicated people with different skills from 23 countries. We have different backgrounds, life stories, and areas of expertise, and we love this diversity because we believe it makes our work and products better.

**What is the role?

**

• Continuous cleaning and maintenance of tap systems installed in and around Copenhagen.

• Setting up and monitoring equipment at festivals and events throughout Denmark in the summer season.

• Assisting Chief Dispense Technician and the team in installing and repairing tap systems with new and existing accounts..

You will report directly to our Chief Dispense Technician.

**You Are All About

**

• Working with teams of co-workers and partners, and not trying to do the work alone.

• A diverse activity throughout the year involves festivals and events during the summer months which essentially also includes travelling.

• Service and the ability to sort problems and build good relationships with our customers.

• You are constantly seeking new knowledge and leading with curiosity.

**Your Qualifications

**

• Industry experience from the bar/restaurant/event scene.

• Proven excellence in problem-solving while being open and service-minded.

• A valid Danish driver's license and work permit.

• Familiarity with Google Workspace and Slack.

• Verbal and written communication skills.

• Professional fluency in English and Danish.

**What We Offer

**

• An opportunity to work in one of the world's 50 best breweries.

• An open and inclusive workplace culture where you have the autonomy and ability to be innovative.

• A team culture of belonging.

• A space to develop and grow as a human being while working in a fast-growing company.

• A challenging and fun place to work.

**How To Apply

**Submit your resume and cover letter, including your answer to the question, through the link. All documents need to be in English.

• Application deadline: Ongoingly

• Job start: December 1st or ASAP

• Contact person: Liam Duffy, liam@to-ol.dk

Senior Product Manager, Scientific Software — Copenhagen

The company

Our client is a venture-backed Copenhagen biotech that designs a new class of oral drugs. It uses its own generative AI, automated chemistry and high-throughput biology. The platform has made and tested hundreds of thousands of novel compounds, and the company has a major pharma partnership behind it. R&D is organised under a CTO across three groups: AI & Computational Drug Design, Platform Chemistry, and Screening Biology.

The role

The Senior Product Manager will own the company's internal scientific software, so every team works from the same clean, consistent data with tools that fit together.

The company creates, moves and decides on large volumes of chemistry and biology data. Today each team builds its own solutions. The company is moving to a new data platform built for its molecules and will build custom internal products on top of it.

The Product Manager is the person who sees that three teams are building three versions of the same thing and turns them into one that works for everyone. Success is measured in time saved for the scientists: the software should save more than it costs.

Responsibilities

Product ownership

• Owns the roadmap for the internal scientific software, starting with the three products above.

• Gathers and challenges requirements from computational design, chemistry and biology, and turns parallel requests into shared solutions.

• Prioritises with the leadership team: what gets built, in what order, and why.

• Makes sure the products connect to each other and to the data platform.

• Runs user testing and adoption with the scientists, and tracks the time saved.

Delivery and leadership

• Works agile, and knows where agility stops. Ships working products within months without painting the platform into a corner.

• Leads and coordinates 3–6 developers, a mix of contractors and hires. A front-end engineer may report directly.

• Helps shape the software team as it grows.

Hands-on, at the start

• Contributes to the build until the development team is in place. The stack is Python on the back end, React/Redux on the front end, and AWS serverless services.

• Judges which components fit together and which will break, including AI-assisted code.

The profile

The ideal candidate has experience from an environment where software is built and shipped, and a scientific background. Beyond that, in order of importance:

• People leadership. Has led developers or cross-functional teams, internal or contracted, and aligned stakeholders who don't report to them.

• Product management track record. Has owned a software product or platform from idea to adoption.

• Drug discovery experience. Has worked close to design, synthesis, screening or compound selection. Broader R&D software is also relevant.

• Scientific background. A chemistry or biology degree (either is fine). Knows what they don't know, and asks.

• Hands-on coding. Can build in Python and React. Judgement matters more than depth.

Mindset: curious enough to ask "what's a canonical SMILES?", pragmatic about agile, and happy to start hands-on and grow into leading a team.

Nice to have: AWS serverless, lab automation or screening data, ELN/LIMS or compound registration, startup or scale-up experience. The working language is English.

Set-up, package and process

• Reporting. To the VP of AI & Computational Drug Design, with a weekly 1:1 and short daily stand-ups.

• Location. On site in Copenhagen, enough to work alongside the chemists and biologists in the lab. There is no fixed number of days.

• Career path. Starts senior and hands-on, and grows into leading a dedicated software team.

• Package. A competitive salary, pension, a performance bonus, and participation in the company's warrant programme.

• Process. A short screening call, then an online session where the candidate presents software they have built, then on-site interviews. The target start is early 2027.

Play a crucial role in an exciting international growth journey

With an IoT platform connecting more millions of devices, and growing - Trackunit is building the connectivity layer underneath the construction industry. Every one of those units carries a cellular radio, and every one of those radios sits inside a web of standards, type approvals, and patent licences that decides whether we can ship and where we can ship.

You will join our IoT Division, Device Reliability Engineering (DRE) team as an expert on IoT certifications, standards, and licensing including Standard Essential Patents (SEP). This position shapes both our exposure and our coverage arguments, and it means this role works in every direction at once, with suppliers, regulatory approvals, legal advisors, product and engineering, and with customers.

This is a role for someone who can hold a genuinely complex domain in their head and then explain it in three sentences to a customer who has never heard the phrase “patent exhaustion.”

Experience level: a deep specialist role. We expect solid, hands-on experience with cellular device approvals and licensing — likely 10+ years across regulatory, certification, or IP/licensing work in mobile, IoT, or telecom hardware. This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports, high autonomy, and direct executive visibility.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

****What's in it for you?

• A domain you will own, not administer. IoT Cellular License, SEP and certification strategy is an executive-level topic at Trackunit right now, with real financial exposure attached. You will not be filing paperwork in a corner, you will be shaping the position the company takes.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****What you'll do

****Your work splits roughly into four parts: licensing, approvals, guidance, and governance.

• Own our SEP position. Understand where our cellular SEP exposure actually sits across our device portfolio, track the relevant patent pools and licensing programmes, and maintain a clear, evidence-based view of what is covered through our supply chain and what is not.

• Run supplier licensing due diligence. Establish and maintain a consistent set of asks across module suppliers — coverage confirmation, standards and generations covered, and honest disclosure of known gaps — so responses can be compared side by side and fed into supplier qualification.

• Support licensing negotiations and claims. Work alongside our General Counsel, external patent counsel, and economic advisors on royalty basis questions, valuation and apportionment arguments, and claims that reach us through our OEM customers. You bring the technical and supply chain substance; they bring the legal strategy.

• Own global type approvals and certification. Plan and steer RED/CE, FCC, ISED, UKCA, and the wider set of regional approvals, plus GCF/PTCRB and carrier certification, across a multi-region device portfolio. Keep certification on the critical path of new product programmes rather than at the end of them.

• Stay ahead of regulatory change. Cyber Resilience Act, RED delegated acts, radio spectrum and network sunsets, environmental and product compliance requirements — know what is coming, when it bites, and what it means for our roadmap.

• Make the complex simple, and guide without over-promising. Write and maintain the internal playbooks, customer-facing explainers, and OEM guidance that turn this domain into something a commercial colleague or a customer can act on. Be the person Sales, Legal, and customers come to when a licensing notification lands, explaining the landscape accurately, saying clearly where the limits of our position are, and pointing customers to independent specialist advice where that is the right answer.

• Build the governance. Response protocols, decision records, escalation paths, and embedding licensing and compliance requirements into how we qualify suppliers and run the product development lifecycle.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

• Communication as a core skill, not a bonus. You can take a genuinely complicated subject and land it in plain language, in writing, with an audience that has no background in it.

• The judgement to know what we can and cannot say to a customer, and the discipline to hold that line even when it would be easier not to.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You are honest about uncertainty. In this domain, no one can offer a blanket guarantee, and the people who claim otherwise create problems later. We would rather be accurate than reassuring.

• You are curious and self-driven, this is a field that changes constantly, and nobody is going to hand you a reading list.

• You finish things. A clear one-page answer delivered this week beats a perfect analysis that arrives after the decision was made.

• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows a subject, and you use that position to make others smarter rather than to make yourself indispensable.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement, but a strong motivation and interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work, including MCP servers and agents against our own platform, and we see clear potential in applying it to research, documentation, and compliance workflows. We don't expect you to have experience with this but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

****How you'll grow here

****This is a specialist role with an unusually wide view of the business, and we've set it up that way on purpose.

• Executive proximity. You will work closely with the SVP of IoT Division, while reporting into a central function for IoT, as the Device Reliability Engineering. You will help in presenting to executive leadership on exposure, risk, and recommendations. Your analysis will inform on a product technical matter (Not Legal) but with real financial and commercial decisions.

• Cross-functional reach. Legal, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales all depend on this domain. Few roles at Trackunit touch as many parts of the company.

• External network. You will work with external patent counsel, economic consultants, module suppliers, certification bodies, and industry forums — building a network that extends well beyond Trackunit.

• Room to define the function. This discipline is being built out now. What it becomes — and whether it grows into a team — is substantially yours to shape.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

Director

CMC Analysis & Characterisation

CMC Analytical Execution & Technology

Location: Måløv

Your impact begins here - **Set the direction. Accelerate delivery. Transform analytical execution.

**Are you a bold and inspiring leader who can turn complexity into clear direction and strong results? As Director of CMC Analytical Execution & Technology (AET), you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of approximately 150 employees, ensure reliable analytical delivery across a growing development portfolio, and shape the future of automation, digitalisation, and analytical technology. This is an opportunity to combine visible operational leadership with strategic influence - and build the people, partnerships, and capabilities that will advance medicines from development to patients. Apply now and help shape the future of analytical execution.

**What You’ll Do

**As Director for CMC AET, you will lead a multi-disciplinary area consisting of five operational analytical teams, one IT team, and one Technology Engineering team. Together, these teams are responsible for delivering analytical results across the entire development project portfolio, while driving digitalization, automation, and technology advancement across the area. You will ensure reliable, compliant, and efficient operations through strong leadership, clear prioritization, robust resource planning, and close collaboration with key stakeholders.

At the same time, you will define and execute the strategic roadmap for analytical execution, digital capabilities, and technology innovation, ensuring scalable solutions and future-ready capabilities that support an expanding portfolio and increasing business complexity.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be

**

• Lead people and organisational capability: set a clear direction, develop leaders and talents, and build a high-performing organisation with the capabilities required to support current and future business needs.

• Drive performance and execution excellence: ensure reliable, compliant, and timely analytical delivery through strong operational leadership, clear accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement.

• Set strategic direction: define and drive the long-term strategy for analytical execution, validation, release readiness, and technology enablement, balancing business priorities, future capability needs, and regulatory expectations.

• Lead and build strategic partnerships: establish trusted stakeholder relations across the value chain and create alignment around priorities, capacity, risks, and resource investments to enable successful portfolio delivery.

• Shape the future through technology and innovation: define the vision and strategic direction for automation, digitalisation, and future ways of working across AnaC. Influence organisational priorities and investments to build the capabilities needed to meet future portfolio and business demands.

Your success requires a visible, hands-on operational leadership profile combined with strong strategic judgement. You stay close to execution performance, use KPIs and lead-time data to drive action, identify risks and constraints early, and work proactively with stakeholders to remove barriers and protect delivery. With full decision authority, you set objectives with significant functional impact and take accountability for people decisions, operational performance, strategic capability development, and successful project transfers from Research to Global Manufacturing & Supply.

You report to the Vice President (VP) of CMC Analysis & Characterisation (AnaC) and will be part of the leadership team in AnaC.

**Who You’ll Work With

**CMC AnaC is responsible for analytical development, characterisation, bioanalysis, stability, comparability, validation, release and lifecycle analytical support across Novo's product portfolio.

CMC AET consists of approximately 150 employees in Måløv, organised across five execution teams responsible for validation and QC/release testing, as well as a technology team and an IT team. The department is accountable for strong day-to-day analytical execution, predictable delivery, and transparent performance management, while strategically developing the automation, digital solutions, technologies, and capabilities required for the future analytical landscape.

We offer a dynamic and fast-paced environment where operational excellence, innovation, and collaboration go hand in hand. We take ownership, challenge the status quo, and are committed to delivering high-quality analytical support to patients and the business.

**What You’ll Bring

**We are looking for a seasoned and self‑motivated leader who thrives on taking initiative and ownership. You bring:

• An MSc (minimum) and + 5 years of relevant experience, with significant experience within QC, analytical development or other relevant CMC or Product Supply disciplines.

• + 5 years of proven leadership experience with the ability to lead multi‑disciplinary teams and deliver results at a strategic level. Senior leadership experience is a requirement.

• Broad cross‑functional experience within CMC Development, with strong organisational understanding and the ability to influence at VP level.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present complex scientific and strategic topics to senior management.

• A demonstrated track record of driving change, challenging the status quo, and improving business outcomes.

• A strong Lean mindset and experience applying continuous improvement principles to simplify workflows, reduce lead times, improve capacity utilisation and build sustainable operational performance.

You lead with confidence, energy, and trust, creating clarity in complexity and belief in times of uncertainty. You set a strong tone of ownership and optimism - “we’ve got this” - and lead in line with Novo leadership behaviours by delivering on commitments, developing others, challenging constructively, and making decisions for the greater good.

**What You Can Expect Here

**At Novo, you can expect a role where your scientific judgement matters, your ideas are listened to, and your work helps move complex development projects forward. You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, build cross-functional influence and grow in a collaborative environment where initiative is encouraged. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership, while contributing to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 940,800 to DKK 1,448,700, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short‑term and/or long‑term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. Apply before: 8 November 2026.

**Due to short deadline please apply as fast as possible.

**For further information, please contact VP CMC AnaC, Kristine Buch Uldahl, at kbuu@novonordisk.com

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying for this Director position in your CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo in your CV.

**About ALK

**ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specializing in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation.

**The position

**ALK is looking for a strategic and experienced Director, Finance Digital Transformation, to lead the contribution from Finance’s to the SAP S/4HANA transformation and drive the continuous development of ALK’s Finance application landscape.

In this role, you will ensure that finance requirements, controls, data integrity, and reporting needs are embedded in the future ERP landscape. You will also lead the roadmap for SAP, BW/BI, AI, and automation initiatives while building a centre of excellence for finance applications and projects.

As the primary interface between Finance, Global Business IT (GBIT), and external implementation partners, you will play a key role in shaping how technology enables Finance across ALK.

**Responsibilities

**

• Lead the Finance workstream in the SAP S/4HANA transformation from requirements and design through testing, cutover, and hypercare.

• Represent Finance in programme governance and manage finance-related risks, decisions, controls, data migration, and reporting requirements.

• Develop and maintain Finance’s application and technology strategy in cooperation with the Global Finance Board.

• Lead, develop, and motivate a team of 3–5 finance application and project specialists.

• Oversee the operation, maintenance, improvement, and governance of core finance applications, including SAP, BW/BI, and related finance systems.

• Identify and lead opportunities involving AI, automation, advanced analytics, and self-service reporting.

• Manage the Finance IT project portfolio, including prioritisation, resourcing, delivery, and status reporting.

• Coordinate system releases, upgrades, testing, access management, documentation, training, and user support.

• Ensure appropriate finance master data management and coordinate Finance IT audit deliverables.

• Act as the primary Finance partner to GBIT, SAP implementation partners, technology vendors, and external consultants.

**Experience And Qualifications

**

• Master’s degree in Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.

• At least 8 years of experience in finance systems, finance IT, or related roles.

• Hands-on experience with SAP finance modules; experience with SAP S/4HANA is strongly preferred.

• Experience leading or playing a senior role in a major ERP transformation.

• Knowledge of BW/BI platforms and finance reporting or planning solutions.

• Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics in a finance context is an advantage.

• Proven people leadership experience, preferably managing a team of specialists.

• Strong project and programme management skills; relevant certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is an advantage.

• Strong understanding of finance systems integration, governance, controls, and data management.

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and negotiation skills.

• Structured, analytical, and process-oriented approach with a strong focus on continuous improvement.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

**We Offer

**ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process. We consider our pioneering spirit, coupled with our trustworthiness, our winning formula.

**_Denmark

_**Our offices in Denmark offer a green view of the DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We believe that physical presence enforces strong teamwork and collaboration and creates success, so it is important that you enjoy coming to work at our site with a degree of flexibility to also work from home.

**_Poland

_**ALK GBSC offers a safe and healthy workspace in a modern office (Aleja Pokoju 1) that features the best of Danish design, including an open floorplan, wooden flooring, stand-up desks, a chill-out room and a fully equipped kitchen with the best view in Kraków.

Join us at ALK and be a part of an organization that values integrity, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve.

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

**Fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK

**At ALK, we believe that every candidate deserves to be evaluated fairly and respectfully. Our recruitment process is designed to give each applicant an equal opportunity, regardless of their background. Read more about fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK.

If you are applying from North America, please know that we are committed to fair, unbiased and non-discriminatory recruitment practices and to complying with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws. For more information, please visit the official websites of the relevant authorities: U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) and Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP).

Your primary focus will be regulatory compliance relating to Omnigame’s B2C operations, specifically its Danish-licensed online casino activities and, as relevant, future B2C markets.

In this role, you will support the day-to-day management of regulatory requirements applicable to Omnigame’s B2C operations, ensuring that regulatory obligations are identified, implemented and appropriately documented across the business. You will work closely with relevant stakeholders across the organization, including Safer Gambling, AML, Technology and Commercial.

As Omnigame continues to develop its business and enter new markets, the role will provide opportunities to participate in regulatory projects, licence applications and the implementation of new regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Maintain expert and up-to-date knowledge of legislation, regulations, licence conditions, regulatory guidance and technical requirements applicable to Omnigame’s B2C gambling operations.

• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on Omnigame’s B2C activities, ensuring that relevant requirements are communicated to and implemented by the appropriate business functions.

• Support the business on day-to-day B2C regulatory compliance matters and provide practical guidance on the interpretation and implementation of regulatory requirements.

• Coordinate and support regulatory reporting, notifications and other submissions to relevant gambling authorities.

• Support the maintenance of Omnigame’s existing B2C gambling licences and assist with applications for licences in new jurisdictions.

• Support regulatory implementation projects, including changes to products, platforms, games, suppliers and operational processes.

• Monitor compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and identify regulatory risks, deficiencies and areas for improvement.

• Recommend appropriate remediation measures and coordinate their implementation with relevant stakeholders.

• Work closely with the Safer Gambling and AML teams to ensure that regulatory developments and operational changes are appropriately reflected in Omnigame’s safer gambling, AML/CFT, sanctions and player-protection framework.

• Coordinate and support regulatory inspections, audits, information requests and other interactions with gambling authorities.

• Maintain appropriate regulatory documentation, evidence, registers and compliance records.

• Provide regulatory input into new products, features and business initiatives and participate in relevant cross-functional projects.

• Develop and deliver regulatory training and guidance to relevant stakeholders where required.

• Support the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Compliance and Chief Legal & Compliance Officer on B2C regulatory and compliance projects.

**Qualifications And Experience

• A relevant higher education degree within law, business law, compliance, governance, risk management or a comparable field.

• Approximately 3–5 years’ relevant experience, preferably from the gambling sector; experience from another highly regulated sector, audit, consultancy, risk or compliance may also be relevant.

• Experience with regulatory compliance within online gambling or another highly regulated industry, with B2C gambling regulation being a particular advantage.

• Experience interpreting regulatory requirements and translating them into practical operational requirements, controls and procedures.

• Experience with regulatory reporting, licence applications and/or regulatory change management is an advantage.

• Ability to draft and maintain clear company policies and operational procedures.

• High degree of integrity, initiative, attention to detail and ability to work effectively in time-sensitive situations.

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written, with strong communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions and seniority levels.

**Bonus Skills

**

• Knowledge of auditing principles and practices.

• Knowledge of data governance and data protection principles.

• Experience providing specialized regulatory or compliance training.

• Additional language skills.

We are looking for a CRM & Lifecycle Manager to join Hårklinikken as we continue to develop and grow our global ecommerce business.

We operate six Shopify sites across the US, UK, EU, Denmark, Iceland and the UAE, with the US representing our largest growth market and subscriptions playing a central role in our model.

You will own the CRM and lifecycle journey across our markets, building the communication, flows and experiences that help turn first-time clients into long-term relationships. From onboarding and treatment support to subscriptions, repeat purchase, loyalty and win-back, you will help clients stay engaged, consistent and cared for throughout their journey with us.

Working hands-on in Klaviyo and Recharge, you will use data and customer insights to understand where clients engage, where they drop off and what helps them stay. You will continuously test and improve the lifecycle journey, with a particular focus on the first 90 days and subscription retention.

Success in this role means improving 90-day retention, increasing the number of subscribers who stay for at least three deliveries, strengthening repeat purchase rates and growing CRM revenue across markets.

You will track cohorts and LTV by market and share what you learn, helping those insights shape our wider acquisition and ecommerce activities.

Primary Relationships

You will report to the Global Director of Ecommerce and work closely with the Senior Ecommerce Manager as part of our ecommerce team in Copenhagen.

You will also collaborate closely with Brand, our clinics and our Client Care Teams, particularly around campaigns, the client journey, loyalty and client feedback.

You will work closely with our Content Marketing Manager, providing clear briefs for CRM campaigns and customer communications.

Key Responsibilities

• Klaviyo. Build and run flows, segments, campaigns and SMS across six markets, working with our Content Marketing Manager who develops copy from your briefs.

• The first 90 days. Own the onboarding journey for new clients, helping them start their treatment right and stay with it.

• Subscriptions in Recharge. Manage sign-ups, retention, churn and win-back, testing what helps subscribers stay longer.

• Consultation to treatment. Develop booking reminders and post-consultation flows that help turn consultations into lasting treatments, both in our clinics and at home.

• Loyalty, reviews and client feedback. Work closely with our Client Care Team to understand where clients get stuck and what brings them back.

• The campaign calendar. Coordinate the campaign calendar so CRM, the site and paid media go live at the same time with the same message.

Core Competencies

This role requires strong CRM and lifecycle experience combined with a hands-on, structured and analytical approach. You are comfortable working with data, understanding customer behaviour and turning insights into actions that strengthen retention.

You keep many moving parts on track and care about the client, not just the open rate. You understand how to grow retention through value rather than discounts, and you know when one email is one too many. You don't need to tick every box to be the right fit. We would love to hear from you if you bring strong CRM or lifecycle experience, a customer-focused mindset, a genuine interest in building relationships that last and supporting our mission

What You Bring:

• 3-5 years of experience in CRM, retention or lifecycle marketing, ideally within DTC ecommerce.

• Strong hands-on Klaviyo skills, with experience building flows, segments and templates yourself.

• Experience with subscriptions, ideally Recharge.

• A track record of delivering results that you can demonstrate through data.

• Confidence working with data, with the ability to read a cohort and understand what to test next.

• Fluent English.

It is an advantage if you also have:

• Experience working across several markets or Shopify storefronts, ideally including the US.

• Experience with a premium beauty, wellness or personal care brand with a regimen or subscription model.

• Experience with loyalty or review platforms.

• Proficiency in a Scandinavian language.

Who Are We?

Founded in 1992 in Copenhagen, Hårklinikken is a leading scalp and hair health clinic with more than 30 years of experience. We help clients achieve optimal scalp health and long-lasting hair gain, combining expert guidance with clean and gentle products formulated to support healthy hair growth.

Our approach began with Hårklinikken’s founder and lead researcher, Lars Skjøth, who developed a diagnostic, consultation-based approach centred around understanding each client’s individual scalp and hair needs. Today, The Hårklinikken Method brings together decades of expertise with the personalised care that has been at the heart of Hårklinikken from the beginning.

Clients come to us in different ways, whether through a consultation or by discovering and purchasing our products online. Through virtual consultations or in person at our clinics in New York, Beverly Hills, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Dubai and Reykjavik, our Hair Specialists combine their expertise with an individual assessment of each client’s scalp, hair, lifestyle and environment to create a personalised regimen designed around their specific needs.

However their journey begins, we are here to guide and support our clients along the way. From helping them find what is right for their individual needs to supporting them in achieving the best possible results, we want every client to feel confident, understood and cared for throughout their Hårklinikken journey.

We’re on a mission to help as many people as possible achieve fuller, stronger, healthier hair with products that are powered by science, perfected by experts and proven by over 100,000 clients.

What We Offer

• A new team, where you shape how we work from day one.

• Full ownership of CRM and subscriptions across six markets.

• Short decision paths in an owner-led company.

• Close collaboration with our clinics, where the treatment starts.

• A real work-life balance, with flexibility in how you plan your day.

• An international team and modern clinics with a strong focus on quality and aesthetics.

• Growth opportunities in a safe work environment.

• Pension, holiday allowance and discounts on our products and treatments.

The role reports to the Global Director of Ecommerce and is based on site in Copenhagen. It is a permanent, full-time position, starting as soon as possible and ideally no later than 1 March 2027.

Supply Chain Launch Manager for global launch projects

Would you like to help orchestrate the global launch of new products, representing our supply chain throughout the entire launch projects?

Join a global group of skilled supply chain professionals and follow new products from early development all the way to market – as your input will ensure that we deliver the best products to people with intimate healthcare needs.

“WE play a key part in planning and executing successful launches – and we are a valued voice in the process, allowing us to set a clear direction,” explains Head of Supply Chain Launch, Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen.

Join our highly experienced Launch department

Together, we are 7 colleagues, responsible for supply chain activities related to bringing new and innovative products to market within Chronic Care and Wound Care products. A good part of our time, we spend working with our factories in Hungary, Costa Rica, and soon Portugal.

“As we are each dedicated to different projects, discussing what we’ve learned with each other is very important to us. And we’ll be there to make sure you get to ease into the position,” says Daniel.

Ensure that supply chain is covered in every project

As part of the Coloplast global supply chain, you will find yourself in the middle of a web of stakeholders working towards launching new Chronic Care and Wound Care products. Here, you will be dedicated to specific projects, acting as supply chain lead or subject matter expert, representing the voice of supply chain and making sure supply chain is on track for launch.

Specifically, you will be the subject matter expert from supply chain, staying up to date on project progression. Moreover, you will plan the launch and make sure that systems, manufacturing, stock levels, etc. are ready for launch. And when you meet a bump in the road, you will figure out solutions with the project team.

From early project development until post-launch, you will:

•    Influence project decisions and direction early, to avoid supply chain risks

•    Drive the supply chain plan with manufacturing sites, balancing project deliverables and commercial considerations to launch on time

•    Produce launch scenarios in collaboration with other departments and ensure alignment with the rest of the organization

•    Coordinate activities at our production sites and flag supply chain risks

•    Make sure systems, such as planning, base data and distribution, are ready for launch

•    Follow up on delivery performance of newly launched items after launch

Your work may take you traveling roughly 2 weeks per year, primarily to our factory in Hungary. However, you will have a say on how the trips are planned, so they will fit with the rest of your life.

Supply chain knowledge and stakeholder management skills

In this role, you must be able to work cross-functionally, using your good stakeholder management skills to incorporate a wide range of input from across the business. Also, you can work with limited supervision in your projects, representing the voice of supply chain, making decisions, and setting a direction for your area.

Finally, we imagine that you:

•    Have a degree in supply chain or engineering

•    Have some experience, either within supply chain or logistics and a good conception of production processes

•    Possibly have some experience working in projects, allowing you to consider both commercial and supply chain perspectives

•    Are good at Excel and at adapting to new systems

•    Are fluent in English

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Head of Supply Chain Launch,

Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen on DKDAAR@coloplast.com. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences.
